newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to weaker.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to weaker on Tuesday, traders said.
Gasoline prices were little changed. Traders said the market was looking to U.S. stocks data and NYMEX futures for fresh direction after the long weekend holiday.
Naphtha prices stayed easy but tighter Mediterranean supplies and interest to ship product to the Far East was underpinning the market against slack demand in NWE.
Gas oil slid about $1 a tonne in line with weaker May futures but premiums were around unchanged in slow talk.
High sulphur fuel barges traded at $81 and $81.50 fob ARA, slipping $2 from Monday levels described as "artificial." Bunker demand was moderate.
